findings.title: The wrapper's Bash limits do not reach the provider CLI
facts: ruling Stop A: the provider child inherits the launching process environment whole (abg/actor_process.ts:865) - true of the installed CLI process

the harness launches that CLI with a filtered environment: the driver's commandRecorder uses setupEnvironment(config) (exact-candidate-qualification.mjs:59-61, :317): HOME, PATH, TMPDIR, LANG, LC_ALL and toolchainEnvironment (JAVA_HOME); the UAT runner's workerEnvironment adds provider.inheritEnvironment (runner.mjs:113-120)
the operator configuration names ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in provider.inheritEnvironment and neither BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS nor BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
the transport removes only its sanitized prefixes (abg/transport_contracts.ts:262-272, :367-383), so a name present in the CLI process environment reaches the provider
remedies: the dispatch path composes the CLI environment as workerEnvironment(config) plus the two names
or the operator configuration names the two in provider.inheritEnvironment
